## Type of change

Match the `type` used in the branch name / commit history ([conventions/git.md](../conventions/git.md)):

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `style` — formatting, no code meaning change
- [ ] `refactor` — no functional change
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `test` — adding or correcting tests
- [ ] `build` — build system or dependencies
- [ ] `ci` — CI configuration
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, maintenance
- [ ] `revert` — reverts a previous commit

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows the relevant convention doc(s) in `conventions/` for the languages/frameworks touched
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing locally
- [ ] Linter/formatter/type-checker run clean
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or debug output committed
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behavior or setup changed
- [ ] Migrations included and reviewed, if applicable
